component.name: OneBrowser Zen
component.summary: Zen Browser–inspired streaming and entertainment browser for Linux

description.p: OneBrowser Zen is a modern Linux desktop browser engineered specifically for streaming, entertainment, and distraction-free browsing on Bazzite Linux and modern Wayland desktops.

ul.li: Zen Vertical Sidebar with drag-and-drop tab reordering, pinning, audio mute controls, and context menus
Multi-Workspace system (Streaming, Entertainment, Gaming, Social, Work) with persistent session recovery
Immersive Cinema Mode (F11 / Ctrl+Shift+I) and native Picture-in-Picture (PiP) video controls
Side-by-Side Dual Split View (Ctrl+Shift+S) for simultaneous live stream and chat/wiki browsing
Hardware-accelerated VA-API, Vulkan, and Mesa RADV video decoding with 16-connection ZeroDownloader

description.p: Initial Zen Browser–inspired Linux release with Vertical Workspaces, Immersive Cinema Mode, Split View, and Bazzite Flatpak + AppImage support.
